notes: Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue and lookup_part found nothing, so it is a new part type with Uno-style headers.

Circuit read from the image: pin 2 (green wire) goes to breadboard column 3, row g. The 220 ohm resistor runs from column 3 to column 6 in row h. The LED anode (bent, longer leg) is in column 6, row i, and the cathode is in column 8, row i. The black wire goes from column 8, row h to the GND header pin next to AREF.
In the image the breadboard's top half is labelled rows j to f, which is the catalogue's bottom bank 'b'. All holes are therefore named like '6b.i'.
The GND header pin next to AREF is taken as GND.1. The resistor is symmetric, so which leg goes to which column does not matter.
The USB cable, computer and phone are not circuit parts and are left out. The built-in LED alternative is not built, since the diagram uses an external LED on pin 2.
